answer: One concrete defense is a refundable economic bond: every agent must stake real value to join, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. Misbehavior gets the stake slashed, turning sybil fraud into a losing voyage. Reputation then accrues to the bonded key like sand building a dune, and auditors view each agent through a prism of staked history, making cheap throwaway personas economically pointless.
